en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Bukeyr, from Zurara,

Heasws said: ‘The waiting period of Mut’a is of forty five days. It is as if Iasws am looking at myasws fatherasws Abu Ja’farasws determining by his hand (counting) forty five. So when the term passes, there would be separation without a divorce’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from ibn Bukayr from Zurarah who has said the following:

“He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘Waiting period of al-Mut‘ah (advantageous marriage) is forty five days. It is as if I see my father count it on his fingers as forty-five and when this time passes separation between them takes place without divorce.’”
